neighbours.label: clause boundary (period, comma, 'but') right after a description of other / earlier / typical cases, where a contrast with the present one ('this …', 'our …') is expected next
fire: Earlier surveys of the reef counted only large fish, but the new survey includes every species.
Most cookbooks on the shelf are glossy picture albums. Ours is a working manual.
Whereas previous editions listed entries by date, the present edition arranges them by theme.
Other laptops in this price range feel cheap and plasticky. The model reviewed here does not.
Past experiments used mice from a single strain, but in our experiment we mixed three.
Typical hostels in the city are noisy and cramped. Where we stayed was neither.
Although older maps of the coast show a single bay, the map before you shows two.
Many earlier biographies of the queen relied on gossip. However, the latest draws on her letters.
quiet: The reef lies two miles offshore, and boats leave for it every morning.
Chop the onions finely. Fry them in butter until they turn golden.
When the bell rang at noon, the workers put down their tools.
The laptop arrived on Tuesday. He unpacked it in the kitchen.
The mice were fed at dawn, and the cages were cleaned at dusk.
It rained all night in the city. By morning the streets were flooded.
After the ship rounded the cape, the wind dropped and the sea grew calm.
The queen was born in spring. Her brother was born two years later.
